# ATLAS Agency

> Websites for small businesses in New York City: restaurants, salons, contractors and shops. You see a free preview of your new site first, and pay only if you launch it.

- Website: https://agency.storefront.test/
- Courses, ebooks, PDFs and kits (ATLAS Academy store): https://agency.storefront.test/academy/ (its own list: https://agency.storefront.test/academy/llms.txt)
- Email: owner@example.com
- Phone:+1 555 010 0142
- Serves: the five boroughs of New York City
- Website Package: $500. Pages, search basics, a call or booking bar, an AI chat assistant, and a check before launch.
- How it works: we look at your current site (or none), build a free preview around your business, and you decide whether to launch it.
- What it will not do: no invented reviews, ratings or figures on your site, and no online card payments on store pages.

Run by Miro (Myron Mekhael). The website is the source of truth for the offer.
